findings.clinical_note: Markedly elevated creatinine indicating acute‑on‑chronic renal impairment; high risk of uremia and requires dose adjustment of renally cleared medications.

findings.test_name: Glomerular filtration rate [Volume Rate/Area] in Serum or Plasma by Creatinine-based formula (MDRD)/1.73 sq M
findings.reference_range: >90 normal, 60‑89 mild reduction, 30‑59 moderate reduction, 15‑29 severe reduction, <15 kidney failure
findings.clinical_note: eGFR 46.5 corresponds to CKD stage 3a; increased cardiovascular risk and warrants nephrology referral.

findings.test_name: Protein [Mass/volume] in Urine by Test strip
findings.clinical_note: Significant proteinuria suggesting glomerular injury; quantify with urine protein‑to‑creatinine ratio and evaluate for CKD progression.

findings.test_name: Bilirubin.total [Mass/volume] in Urine by Test strip
findings.clinical_note: Positive urine bilirubin may reflect hepatobiliary disease or hemolysis; obtain serum bilirubin and liver enzymes.

findings.test_name: Hemoglobin.gastrointestinal.lower [Presence] in Stool by Immunoassay --1st specimen
findings.clinical_note: Positive fecal occult blood; requires gastrointestinal evaluation for possible bleeding source.
